system_name: Sample Connected & Automated Vehicle E/E Architecture
system_description: Reference vehicle electronic and electrical architecture representing a connected passenger vehicle for Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) in compliance with UN Regulation No. 155 and ISO/SAE 21434.

components.name: Telematics Control Unit (TCU)
components.description: Embedded controller handling long-range wireless connectivity, telematics telemetry, emergency eCall, and remote vehicle operations.
critical_functions: Remote OTA firmware reception
Vehicle location and telematics telemetry dispatch
Cellular communication with OEM backend
Short-range wireless pairing (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)

components.name: Central Gateway (CGW)
components.description: High-assurance central gateway controller responsible for domain separation, message routing, protocol translation, firewall filtering, and diagnostic security.
critical_functions: Inter-domain routing between Ethernet and CAN buses
Stateful packet inspection and CAN frame filtering
Diagnostic session management and security access authentication
Secure onboard communication (SecOC) verification

components.name: Infotainment Unit (IVI)
components.description: In-vehicle infotainment and multimedia head unit providing digital cluster integration, consumer device interfaces, navigation, and passenger apps.
critical_functions: Media playback and user display rendering
Smartphone integration (CarPlay, Android Auto)
Passenger Wi-Fi hotspot and Bluetooth audio
USB firmware and media reading

components.name: OBD-II Diagnostic Port
components.description: Physical 16-pin diagnostic connector located under the dashboard enabling dealership and aftermarket diagnostic tools to access vehicle buses via UDS.
critical_functions: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) reading and clearing
ECU routine execution and calibration via UDS
Service tool diagnostic communication

components.name: Powertrain ECU
components.description: Safety-critical Electronic Control Unit governing powertrain management, electronic throttle control, engine/motor torque actuation, and transmission states.
critical_functions: Engine and electric drive torque management
Throttle actuation and transmission control
Powertrain failsafe monitoring

components.name: Brake ECU
components.description: Safety-critical Electronic Control Unit controlling hydraulic braking, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS), Electronic Stability Control (ESC), and autonomous emergency deceleration.
critical_functions: Hydraulic brake pressure regulation
Anti-lock braking (ABS) and Electronic Stability Control (ESC)
Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) deceleration actuation

components.name: OTA Backend Server & Mobile App API
components.description: OEM cloud infrastructure hosting firmware repositories, cryptographic signing servers, fleet telematics analytics, and customer mobile application endpoints.
critical_functions: Firmware update package generation, signing, and dispatch
Customer mobile API authentication (remote locking, HVAC preconditioning)
Fleet health monitoring and telemetry ingestion

trust_boundaries.name: External Wireless Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Demarcates unauthenticated cellular radio frequency, public Wi-Fi, and open Bluetooth environments from vehicle-mounted wireless transceivers.

trust_boundaries.name: Physical Diagnostic and Peripheral Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Demarcates user-accessible physical vehicle connections (OBD-II port, consumer USB sockets) from internal vehicle networks.

trust_boundaries.name: Infotainment Domain Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Separates the rich-OS consumer multimedia domain (IVI) from the vehicle security gateway, restricting direct control bus access.

trust_boundaries.name: Central Gateway Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Isolates external-facing network domains (telematics, diagnostic, IVI) from safety-critical vehicle internal control buses.

trust_boundaries.name: Critical Vehicle Control Network Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Encloses the high-integrity powertrain and chassis CAN buses where actuator command frames (torque, brake pressure) circulate.

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud Backend and Mobile API Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Separates OEM cloud data centers and public mobile client applications from vehicle telematics edge nodes.
